welcome:
Welcome to the emoji, sticker and photo studio!

Emoji packs: First 3 free, then 50 ⭐ per pack.
Photos: 5 welcome uses + 1 daily use, refreshed at 00:00 UTC. Daily uses do not accumulate. Extra use: 20 ⭐.
AI Grid Studio: First pack free, then 100 ⭐ per pack. Templates and prompts are free.

Choose a service. Use /cancel to cancel a new input flow.
studio_grid_prompt: Choose a Studio grid size (1×1–9×9). Get a blueprint and prompt, generate an image in your preferred AI tool, then send it here. First Studio pack free; subsequent packs cost 100 ⭐.
studio_blueprint: {grid}×{grid} reference blueprint, 1024×1024. Coordinates and numbers identify cells. The checkerboard indicates transparency; it is only a guide.
studio_prompt_help: Copy the prompt below and replace the text in square brackets with your subject. Use the blueprint as a layout reference in your image generator.
studio_ai_prompt: A seamless {grid}x{grid} sticker grid sprite sheet containing [SUBJECT / THEME / CHARACTER NAME HERE], each equally sized cell featuring a unique expressive asset on a solid clean white background, high quality vector style, sharp outlines, sticker border, no overlapping, 8k resolution. Keep each asset within its own cell with padding; no grid lines, coordinate labels, numbers or text in the final image. Square 1:1 aspect ratio. For Midjourney: --ar 1:1
studio_upload: Generate the {grid}×{grid} sprite sheet, then send the generated image here (not the blueprint). Upload as a PNG file to preserve transparency. White backgrounds stay white. Use a caption for the pack title. You will choose emoji or stickers after uploading.
studio_format_prompt: Choose the output for this image. Both formats use the same Studio allowance: first pack free, then 100 ⭐.
emoji_upload: Send a photo or PNG/WebP/JPEG file for a {grid}×{grid} pack. Send as a file to preserve transparency and quality. Use the image caption as the pack title.
photo_upload: Send your photo. Upload as a file for the best quality. Detected faces will be hidden; check the result, as automatic detection can miss faces.
no_faces: No faces detected. No free uses or Stars were consumed. Send another image.
invalid_image: The image could not be read or is too large. Send a single-frame PNG/WebP/JPEG up to {mb} MB (up to {pixels} million pixels).
expected_image: Please send a photo or a PNG/WebP/JPEG image file.
private_only: Please use this bot in a private chat.
cancelled: New input flow cancelled. Issued invoices and processing jobs remain active.
invoice_description: One operation on this image. Price: {stars} Telegram Stars. The invoice is valid for the configured period; failed operations are refunded.
payment_prompt: This operation costs {stars} ⭐. Pay the invoice below. Your image is temporarily stored until payment and processing finish.
payment_invalid: This invoice is invalid, expired or already used. Please start a new operation.
photo_done: {count} faces hidden. Your lossless PNG is ready. Check that all faces are hidden.
failed: The operation failed. Any reserved free use was restored; if you paid, a Stars refund has been initiated.
refunded: Your payment of {stars} ⭐ has been refunded.
terms:
Terms

Emoji packs: First 3 free, then 50 ⭐ each. Face censorship: 5 welcome uses plus 1 non-accumulating daily use, then 20 ⭐ per operation. Daily uses are consumed first. AI Studio: 1 separate lifetime free pack, then 100 ⭐ per pack in either output format. Blueprints and prompts are free; you generate the artwork in an external tool under its own terms and prices.
Pack images are center-cropped to a square and carry the bot's name. Transparency is preserved where present; white backgrounds are not removed. Detailed stickers may use reduced colors to fit Telegram's file limit. Face detection is imperfect; inspect the result before sharing.
Files are deleted after completion or invoice expiry. Checkout-approved images may be retained for an extra 24 hours for delayed payment updates. Job and payment records are retained for support. Copies of files sent through Telegram may remain there.
Failed paid operations are automatically refunded. Support: {support}. Telegram support cannot resolve purchases through this bot.
accept_terms: I have read and accept the terms
terms_required: Read and accept the terms before paying. Then open this job's invoice using the button below.
support:
Payment and service support: {support}
Include your payment receipt. Telegram support does not handle purchases through this bot.
stale_action: This selection is no longer active. Start again from the main menu.
already_submitted: A job is already saved for this image. Use /status to check it.
